name: fresh-review
description: Code review with enforced producer/reviewer context separation. Runs the lattice review, the gstack security audit, and a background cross-model Codex pass against one shared diff packet via context-isolated subagents, then triages the findings back in the producer context and logs the run. A second mode reviews a PR — yours or someone else's, by number or URL — and adds a plain-English account of what the change does in the repo's own DDD vocabulary, written from the code alone so it can contradict the PR description. Deliberately skips gstack's /review — /ship runs that on the final diff — and ships a dispatch gate that trims the parts of ship's own review army this run already covered.
